title: fix(spec): one homeAmount refusal names both faults of a home or rate field
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VcRFhGUei2bW39W6pCoKQt)_
Fixes #28205

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`homeAmount` 的 home / rate 字段同时缺 `readonly: true` 又带 `expression` 时,一条拒收文案同时点名两个毛病和两个处方。
- 为什么改:以前只报 readonly,作者改完再 parse 才撞上 expression,要来回两趟。
- 风险与回滚:只改文案,接受集不变,单一毛病的文案一字不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` 的 `refuseUnlessPlatformWritten`;`currency-config-home-amount.test.ts` 新增用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/currency-config-home-amount.test.ts`,预期 32/32 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`refuseUnlessPlatformWritten` (the `currencyConfig.homeAmount` judge in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) used to pick ONE fault: a target without `readonly: true` was told only that, even when it also declared an `expression`. It now computes both faults; when both hold, the one issue at `fields.AMOUNT.currencyConfig.homeAmount.field` (or `.rateField`) names both and both remedies: "Add `readonly: true` to `TARGET` and delete its `expression`." A target with one fault gets exactly the message it got before.

A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec` carries the two declaration lines.

## Why

Triage 6528487750: one refusal names both faults (p3). The author otherwise fixes the readonly fault and meets the expression fault on the next parse.

## Tests

- New `it.each` over `amount_home` / `amount_rate` beside the existing `homeAmount` platform-written refusals: one issue at the pointer, `code: custom`, both fault fragments and the joint remedy.
- Ablation (committed fix first): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the both-faults condition with `false`, so the old single-fault branch answered; the anchor hit 1 → 0, blob 7a8be354 → 9df9b598; the file went 2 failed / 30 passed; restore put the blob back to 7a8be354 and `git diff HEAD` came back empty.

## Acceptance notes

- None. The message text is the only change; no export, schema key or accepted value moves.
